Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075

+91-9884541817

nithyakalyani111999@gmail.com

SUMMARY

Results-driven Fund Accounting professional with 5 years of experience in fund administration of Hedge Funds, UCITS, Mutual Funds, and Bank Loan Operations. Experienced in Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation, cash and position reconciliations, trade processing, settlements, derivatives, fee accruals, and security valuation. Passionate about building a career in Private Equity Fund Accounting, with a strong commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering accurate, high-quality fund accounting services in a dynamic investment environment.

EXPERTISE

End-to-end fund accounting • Cash reconciliation • Trade settlements • NAV calculation • Equities, bonds, and UCITS trades

Listed derivatives management • Redemption calculations • Fee accruals and payables • Corporate actions reconciliation • Cash and position reconciliation • Trade processing and settlements

Nithyakalyani S

EXPERIENCE

October 2025 – June 2026 Bank Loans JP MORGAN CHASE & CO | Bengaluru, Karnataka

Performed Cash and Position reconciliation for Loan funds. • Handled loan securities, paydowns, LIBOR interest, and loan settlements, ensuring compliance with fund terms.

Analyzed Cash, Position breaks and Query with Clients in case of any Discrepancies.

Handled Term loans and DDTL Loans trade bookings and settlements. • Reconciled Market valuation Accrued Interest for Loan securities as per client file.

Performing restructure for the loans. • Reconciling of monthly position balances with the agents for all the portfolios.

Performing controls on daily basis to check upon the activities performed for the day and signing off with the NAV team.

Fund accounting for the loan syndication and trade life cycle of securities.

April 2025 - September 2025 Bank Loans EY (JP MORGAN & CHASE) | Bengaluru, Karnataka

Performed Cash and Position reconciliation for Loan funds. • Handled loan securities, paydowns, LIBOR interest, and loan settlements, ensuring compliance with fund terms.

Analyzed Cash, Position breaks and Query with Clients in case of any Discrepancies.

Handled Term loans and DDTL Loans trade bookings and settlements. • Reconciled Market valuation Accrued Interest for Loan securities as per client file.

Fund accounting for the loan syndication and trade life cycle of securities.

October 2024 - December 2024 Hedge funds BNP PARIBAS | Chennai, India

Fund accounting for the Equity, Bonds & Hedge funds in Weekly and Monthly basis.

Performed trade life cycle activities like Trade Processing, Settlements, and FX Processing.

Subscription/Redemption Processing. • Reconciled cash positions. • Reconciled investment positions and market values. • Valuation of securities as per pricing policy. • Understanding of Trade Processing related Activities. • Excellent knowledge of Capital Markets and Financial instruments. • Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting

• FX processing • Securities valuation per pricing

policy

Corporate actions • Fund accounting • Fund administration • Performing investment operations

Trade life cycle

May 2021 - October 2024 Hedge Funds / UCITS Societe Generale Global Solution Centre | Chennai, India

Performed Calculations of Net Asset Value for the Equity, Bonds & Mutual funds in Daily, Weekly and Monthly basis. • Trade Processing, Settlements, and FX Processing. • Subscription/Redemption Processing. • Quickly Identifying problems and issues in funds, having them resolved with the help of onshore teams within TAT, and signing off funds to counterparts efficiently and in a timely manner.

Reconciled cash positions. • Reconciled investment positions and market values. • Review, update & process transactions related to dividends, interests, corporate actions, equities, bonds, fund shares, portfolio purchase & sales.

Valuation of securities as per pricing policy. • Processed expense and fee accruals. • Handled reconciliation of various OTC Products such as CDS, IRS, FX SWAP.

Setting up new Deal and Position for the Investments and ensuring all the underlying investments are setup correctly in the accounting system.

Reviewed/prepared NAV reporting package on a Daily/Weekly/Monthly /Bi-monthly basis and send it to Onshore for their review.

Identified, analyzed, justified, and resolved material variances with the help of pricing files.

Calculation of performance and crystallization fees in funds. • Ensure adherence to time schedules and quality standards. • Monthly processing of fees from accrual to payable accounts. • Analyzed future and option variations with the help of broker statements. • Processed and worked upon for a specific client, which requires end-to-end work.

Checked for corporate actions and backup securities if there was any variation in the funds.

Responsible for sending pricing requests and pricing queries. • Processed swing for the fund. • Managed the work flow and quality control to deliver portfolio valuation to clients.

Informed the appropriate supervisor regarding accounting or system- related issues occurring within assigned funds.

EDUCATION QUALIFICATION

March 2021 CIBOP | Certified investment banking operational professional Imarticus Learning, Chennai

April 2019 Bachelor of Arts | Commerce Stella Maris College, Chennai

PROJECTS

Redemption Calculations Implementation, Implemented and cross trained huge redemption calculations to the team members which helped them to identify and justify the impacts in the fund. Pricing Checks Implementation, implemented pricing checks to reconcile the securities valuation vs Pricing sources and application. FX and Hedging Calculations Preparation, Prepared file for FX and Hedging calculations which reduced time in calculating the impacts manually.

AWARDS

Star of the month, 01/01/21, For managing the team during pandemic situation with shortage of staffs and delivered all funds without impacting deadline and accuracy.

Spot Award, 10/01/23, For finding the incorrect bookings performed by the accountants which suppressed material impact in the fund. • Star of the month, 01/01/24, For managing, delivering the Funds with quality, implementing new ideas and taking up the off shore supervisor role in a short span of time.

LANGUAGES

Tamil • English
